title: Swiping the tasks to complete them does not update the UI
body:
The most important feature of this app, on which it is based on does not work properly - swiping tasks to complete them does not cross them, they just stay in this swiped position. In order to see the completed task I have to restart the app, which is not very convenient. The word thing is that it's not clear when this happens - sometimes it just works, others it doesn't - I hear the sound of the task being completed, but the UI does not update

Also, the “After I do something” option from the new habit form does not do anything and is being unchecked right after selecting the prior habit
